title: Experience Collection Device
paragraphs: “Hmm… it kind of looks like a dragon, but it’s stitched together.”
“That’s what it seems like. Gaelion-chan, what do you think?”
When Father asked the rival, he tilted his head as well.
“Hmm? It looks like a dragon to Gaelion. But… there’s definitely something that feels off.”
“Either way, we have no choice but to fight, right? Otherwise, we can’t go back.”
Father’s sister stood ready, holding the spear she had received from him.
“Rat, do you see anything?”
“Well… there’s definitely something strange about the joints. Look, around the area between the chest and the waist.”
I stared closely at the spot the doctor pointed out. … I couldn’t see anything unusual. This must be the power of an expert’s knowledge.
“Too much hassle. I’ll just blow it away!”
“Wait, Motoyasu-kun!?”
I couldn’t be bothered, so I charged up my strength and fired my Brionac.
“Brionac X!”
There wouldn’t be anything left.
“AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!”

Its scream was strange. I almost laughed as I launched the Brionac. Then, the enemy generated a massive magic circle in midair and intercepted my Brionac. It looked like it had unleashed an enormous amount of black, glowing magic.
Did it think it could have a shootout with me?
“Foolishness! That level of power won’t stop my attack!”
“I was hoping you’d stop for the sake of coordination, though…”
“No time to talk—”

Before Itsuki could get ready, I took another step forward, putting even more power into it. The enemy had been trying to push back my Brionac, but it had been losing to me from the start. With ease, I pushed through the magic circle, shattering it into pieces. The enemy… let’s call it the demon dragon for now. I blew a hole straight through the demon dragon’s entire body.
Hah! What a weakling.
“Is the battle already over?”
“Even after all that training, every boss-class enemy goes down in one hit.”
“Kind of makes me wonder if getting stronger even matters…”
Ren and Itsuki spoke with a hint of exasperation.
Do they have a problem with that?
“Well… there’s still someone out there that Motoyasu couldn’t beat, so I guess there’s always a stronger opponent.”
“Gaelion can withstand it. A weak dragon like that is no match.”
“Complete victory.”
I raised my spear high in triumph. This was nothing. The rival was still more of a challenge than this.
“Even Gaelion claims he can withstand such a powerful blow. I wonder how that works.”
“Could Naofumi withstand it?”
“When Gaelion conquers Naofumi, he’ll defeat the Spear Hero too!”
“I won’t lose.”
“The greatest enemy is an ally, huh? Well, good luck with that.”
“Since he’s been so useful up to this point, Naofumi should just deal with him already… He said he was interested, didn’t he?”
“Hmm.”
“Uh… can you guys not? You’re killing the tension.”
As we were having that conversation, something floated up and began to shine where the demon dragon had been defeated.
“Hmm? A… fragment of the Dragon Emperor?”
The rival pulled it toward him with magic. He examined the fragment that had flown into his hands. It was glowing with a purplish hue.
“It’s tainted with demonic power… It’s hard to consume like this…”
“Can’t you purify it?”
“I think I can. Gaelion will give it a try.”
The rival said this as he gestured for big sister to come over.
“I need your help. I want to cast light and dark magic together with Gaelion.”
Saying that, the rival took big sister’s hand. She nodded repeatedly and closed her eyes, preparing to chant the spell.
“Come to think of it, Raphtalia-chan can use both light and dark magic, right?”
“Yes, if you use darkness properly, it can help with purification.”
“I’ll do my best.”
“Raphtalia-chan, you got this!”
Big sister friend cheered her on. Soon after, the fragment glowed faintly, and the rival absorbed it.
“Hmm… It’s still not fully purified, but to some extent… huh!?”
The rival’s eyes widened in shock.
“Did you figure something out?”

“The true nature of the Waves… is a man-made disaster caused by those who falsely claim to be gods. And I also learned that reincarnators who appear at turning points in history are part of this too.”
“That’s something we could have guessed, but I guess that means it’s true, huh?”
“There was also knowledge about this place’s history and the demons’ goals sealed within the fragment!”
“That’s interesting. So what’s the history behind this place?”

“This was originally a nation where demi-humans and humans were equals… A country founded by the Four Saint Heroes. The land was developed by the original settlers, just like the other revitalized sites.”
“I figured as much. But why did only this place turn into a nation?”

“That’s because of its good location. Originally, it was a rich and fertile land. But after the death of the Hero, a genius born for the sake of world peace developed a device that made it easy to gain experience. Thanks to that, this land became a place where powerful soldiers could be easily produced.”
Oh… So that’s something they were capable of? If there’s a machine that can gather experience points, we’d definitely want one too.
Hmm? It feels like something Father did when he created the Castle Plant a while ago.
“Do you know why it was destroyed?”

“Hmm! One day, the invention created by that genius went out of control, producing demons and creating an inescapable barrier. On top of that, a magical hazard occurred, contaminating the land and magic, and everything that lived here was wiped out in an instant.”

Father gazed at the weathered bones in front of him. This is the price of relying on a genius. In this world, geniuses are a dangerous gamble. Just look at Takt, and it becomes obvious that nothing good comes from them.
“So, the device went out of control… Does that mean we just need to destroy it?”
“That’s the result, yes. But now I understand why the treasury had so many legendary weapons. They were gathered by the demons.”
“Demons… they were artificially created monsters, weren’t they? Why were they collecting them? Were they planning to invade from the demon realm or trying to take over the world?”
The rival shook his head at Itsuki’s question.

“No, that’s not it. The demons had no intention of ruling the world. Their goal was to gather powerful weapons here to prevent the Four Saint Heroes from being strengthened when the day of reckoning came.”
“Ah… That’s a common trope in games. The demon king’s side hides powerful weapons to keep them out of human hands.”
“So, that’s why the blades were all dulled?”
“They wanted to destroy them but couldn’t, so they hid them instead.”
“But that’s meaningless if the heroes barged in, isn’t it?”

“Still… with all those multiple layers of barriers, no ordinary person could get through. Plus, the legends have been suppressed, and the demons were among the strongest enemies we’ve faced so far, weren’t they?”
“That’s true… And honestly, even with the strengthening of the Four Heroes, the four of us would probably struggle against them.”

“And while they’re staying out of the Waves, they’re operating in the shadows on the other side of the world… hindering the heroes’ growth. They’re doing everything they can to keep the legendary weapons out of our hands.”
“Not showing up during the Waves is cowardly. If they appeared, we could at least track down their base.”
Itsuki muttered bitterly, nodding. That’s certainly true. If we assume that the demons are enemies aligned with the Waves, then storming their base is now on the table.
“They seem to be emerging from somewhere other than the Wave fissures. By staying hidden, they make sure no one gets suspicious enough to investigate. Staying out of sight serves a purpose.”
“Come to think of it, it’s like challenging the Waves using only drop items and custom-made gear. Without access to such exceptional equipment, it’s a much harder fight.”
“They’re like perfect advance scouts for the enemy.”
“And it seems they’re still using that genius’s invention to create demons… and it’s still operational even now.”
“It’s practically a cauldron of the undead.”
“So if we want to escape this place, we have to destroy that ridiculous invention first.”
“We came here hoping to gain experience from the revitalized site, but this turned out to be a complete disaster. It’s basically a hidden dungeon.”
Unbelievable. I don’t recall ever encountering something like this before, but there’s no choice but to move forward.
